typography.headings: Use existing font-display for all large headings. Do not switch to Inter. Apply tight tracking (tracking-tight or tracking-tighter) for massive effect.
typography.body: Clean, readable geometric sans. Keep line heights generous (leading-relaxed) for body paragraphs.
typography.annotations: Caveat handwriting font. Used specifically for small, playful floating notes (e.g., 'This is where you save!' on the calculator).
typography.subtitles: Max width md, greyed out, balanced leading for readability.

colors.primary_description: Dark ink, used as the heavy structural base for 'vault' or outcome cards.
colors.accent_1_description: Mint. Used for positive financial outcomes, primary CTAs, and active slider states.
colors.accent_2_description: Coral. Used for secondary interaction states or danger/warning cues.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Only use high-quality crystal glass (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 or bg-black/60) with a 1px border. Never use muddy gray transparency.
visual_enhancers.neumorphism: Not applicable for this light editorial aesthetic.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px subtle borders (border-black/5 or border-white/10) to separate stacked containers.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle grain texture or a faint grid/checker pattern over the security tinted feature cards to eliminate 'digital flatness'.

grids.bento: Universal bento approach for the calculator page: Use grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 with wide gaps (gap-8 or gap-12). Leave intentional breathing room.
grids.dense: Tight grids for internal UI mockups in feature cards.

layouts.calculator: Redesign RoiCalculator.jsx. Convert to an asymmetric 12-column bento layout. Left Side (Inputs, col-span-7): Clean, spacious area for interactive sliders. Use custom thick slider tracks with mint/coral active states. Add Caveat hand-drawn annotations nearby. Right Side (Outputs, col-span-5): The 'Vault'. Solid Dark Ink (#0F2E33) container, rounded-[28px], p-10. Massive typography for animated total hours and savings. Use Mint (#43D675) for the final metrics to make them glow against the dark background. Integrate the copy-result and Waitlist CTA seamlessly at the bottom.
layouts.security: Rebuild pages/Security.jsx to exactly match the provided reference design. Outer Container: Large rounded-[28px] card with the soft lavender-grey gradient (from-[#E9E9F0] to-[#F4F3F7]) and p-12 md:p-20. Top: Centered small white pill badge (sparkle icon + uppercase tracking-widest label). Headings: Centered ~44px bold display heading and grey 13px subtitle. Hub & Spoke Diagram: Left pills (Asana, Monday), Right pills (Trello, ClickUp), Center Pill (Black #0F2E33 with Fluxvex text/logo). Use 1px orthogonal line elbows to connect them. Bottom Cards: Three equal-width rounded-xl cards with soft tints (lavender #F2EDF8, sky blue #EEF3FA, peach #FAF0E6). Each contains an icon, 15px bold title, 2-line grey description, and a white mini-UI mockup panel embedded at the bottom. Keep all honest pre-launch copy, ComplianceBadges, and Waitlist CTA.

motion.calculator: Animate the 'total hours' and savings outputs on slider change. Use Framer Motion for a smooth counting effect. Add subtle entrance stagger for the input sliders.
motion.interactions: Hover states on CTAs must lift slightly (-translate-y-1) and increase shadow. Sliders must have active/focus states that are accessible.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure white text on Dark Ink background meets WCAG AAA. Ensure slider focus rings are visible. Keep all data-testid attributes perfectly intact for interactive elements.
accessibility.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion for the animated counting.

component_instructions.Sliders: Do not use standard HTML input styles. Apply Tailwind appearance-none and build thick custom tracks and large tactile thumbs.
component_instructions.HubAndSpoke: Use absolute positioned divs with border-t and border-l/r to create the 90-degree orthogonal connector lines. Center them perfectly behind the relative z-10 logo pills.
component_instructions.MiniUIMockups: Build these purely with Tailwind inside the security feature cards. Example: tiny colored progress bars (h-2 rounded-full), bold fake numbers, floating overlapping stat cards, tiny avatar dots, and task rows with minimal tag capsules.

mini_ui_avatars.description: Professional avatar portraits for overlapping dots in the security mini-UI mockups.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Execute the calculator bento grid redesign in RoiCalculator.jsx without removing any existing state logic or data-testids. Add the dark ink container for outputs. 2. Fully replace the Security.jsx UI with the exact reference design instructed. 3. Install 'react-icons' using yarn if not present, and use 'react-icons/si' for the hub-and-spoke brand logos (SiAsana, SiMonday, SiTrello, SiClickup). 4. Use lucide-react for all generic icons (Sparkles, Check, etc.). 5. Strictly apply the defined E1 generous spacing (p-12 to p-20 on large containers) and avoid generic centered 'AI slop' layouts.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do not apply universal transition (transition: all). Use specific transitions. Never center align the main App container globally. Build layered depth with z-index. Do not use AI emojis for icons. Prioritize existing ui components when available.
